Reason: The step misuses the Wikimedia API by adding an Authorization bearer token (unnecessary for read-only queries and likely to cause 401), fails to implement proper pagination via the API’s continue/rvcontinue mechanism (risking counting only the first batch or looping indefinitely when 500 results are returned), and omits rvdir=newer while using rvstart/rvend, which can yield an empty or incorrect range. These issues will prevent obtaining the correct edit count.
